name: Erastus
bio: Erastus, one of Paul's helpers, was sent with Timothy into Macedonia while Paul remained in Asia (Acts 19:22). A greeting from "Erastus the chamberlain of the city" of Corinth was included in Paul's letter to the Romans; this may be the same Erastus Paul earlier sent to Macedonia, though the civic title suggests he may be a different man (Romans 16:23).
